metadata.description: Personal cross-agent skills library — everyday workflows authored once in the portable Agent Skills format.

plugins.name: everyday-skills
plugins.description: Everyday skills: model-council (consult a council of AI models in parallel), cut-to-the-chase (give the reader only what they need), plain-english (common words, short sentences), inception (turn rule lists into principles), align (clarify intent before work), python-style, ml-research-code (write, review and fix ML code), ml-research-critique (experiment design critique), tikz-figure, and beamer-lecture.
